title: Python Polymorphism
description: Polymorphism means 'many forms'. In programming, it refers to methods/functions/operators with the same name that can be executed on many objects or classes. For example, the '+' operator performs addition on numbers but concatenation on strings.

challenges.title: Multi-form Method
challenges.exercise: Create two classes 'Bird' and 'Plane' both with method 'fly()'. Call 'fly()' on each in a loop. Print 'Flying'.
